target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-utm-qemu-probe-current-nov10.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game
checks: GrModels Man generated 112 vertices and 168 triangles; raster diagnostics recorded 2,886 pixel writes.
GrModels Ball generated 58 vertices and 128 triangles; 489 purple inline-sprite pixels were visible.

KeepAway court/HUD/player rendered, mouse and Space input were accepted, scanout changed through 184 seconds with no idle gap, and Escape returned to a working terminal with no Animate child task and zstatus failed=0.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-current-followup.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game
checks: KeepAway rendered, accepted Space/mouse input and refreshed its HUD throughout the 184-second full-game observation; scanout continued changing.
Escape restored terminal focus, 40+2 returned 42, and no Animate child remained after exit.

limits: This is a headless run with UTM's bundled QEMU framework and display/input models, not a test in the visible UTM application window. It confirms this current ISO survives the previously reported KeepAway interval in that accelerated setup, but the live-window freeze report and physical Pi behavior remain open. Audio output was not tested.
